### 🟡 Changes recommended It includes a shader UBO layout change that isn’t accounted for in the PR description, so the rationale/impact needs to be documented (or split into a separate PR). *Once you've addressed the issues Copilot identified, you can request another Copilot review.*
Pull request overview This PR restores `DirAccessJAndroid::make_dir_recursive()` idempotency on Android so callers can safely create cache directories across runs without spurious errors, aligning behavior with the generic `DirAccess::make_dir_recursive()` contract. **Changes:** - Android: Treat an already-existing target directory as `OK` in `DirAccessJAndroid::make_dir_recursive()`. - GLES3: Adjust `DirectionalLightData` UBO padding fields in `scene.glsl` (layout-affecting change).
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `platform/android/dir_access_jandroid.cpp` | Makes Android recursive directory creation idempotent when the directory already exists. | | `drivers/gles3/shaders/scene.glsl` | Changes std140 UBO padding members for `DirectionalLightData` (layout-related shader change). |
Review details - **Files reviewed:** 2/2 changed files - **Comments generated:** 1 - **Review effort level:** Lite
